summary: Anthropic and PwC announced an expanded alliance to deploy Claude Code and Cowork across PwC's global workforce, launch a joint Center of Excellence, and build a new Claude-based Office of the CFO practice for clients.

mechanisms.reason: PwC is deploying agentic Claude systems to replace traditional professional-services workflows in deal-making, finance, and enterprise functions.
mechanisms.quote: PwC is reinventing how it executes deals end-to-end — diligence, value creation, integration — with agents working alongside deal teams.

mechanisms.reason: Scaling Claude deployment to hundreds of thousands of professionals across a major services firm implies a large increase in aggregate token usage.
mechanisms.quote: PwC will roll out Claude Code and Cowork starting with U.S. teams and expanding toward a global workforce of hundreds of thousands of professionals.

categories.reason: Claude usage at this scale runs on the major cloud platforms, incrementally supporting hyperscaler compute demand, though this is only mentioned in passing.
categories.quote: Claude is the only frontier model available on all three of the world's most prominent cloud services, including Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud Vertex AI, and Microsoft Azure.
